config.wynn_weapon_viewer.title: Wynn Weapon Bigger
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.general.contro:
§7Toggle the preview with the Toggle Item Zoom key (default: period). Share an item's card with Ctrl+C while hovering it in any inventory. Change keys in Options → Controls.
§7Commands: /wwb toggle, /wwb config, /wwb reload (type /wwb for help)
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.enabled: Show the big item preview in inventories. The Toggle Item Zoom key and /wwb toggle switch this too.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.showTog: Say so in chat when the toggle key turns the preview on or off.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.shareAc: What happens to a shared item card's image. Saved cards go in your screenshots folder, named after the item and its roll.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.shareRe: Before sharing, flip through the item's tooltip pages (like Wynntils' chat item share does) so its powders show on the card. Takes about a second. Off: shares right away with what's already known.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.showSha: Small print under the preview naming the keys that share the item: Wynntils' Share Item key (in chat) and Ctrl+C (as an image). Shared images never include it.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.display:
Item Card: the item inside a Wynncraft-style card with its rolls, powders and scales.
Floating Item: just the big item, with its name and badges under it.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.scale.t:
How big the preview is, in the free space beside the inventory.
Item Card: 100% fills that space; smaller sizes never go below a normal tooltip.
Floating Item: the share of that space the item takes up.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.alignme: Which side of the inventory the preview goes on. On the left it hides while the recipe book is open.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.xOffset: Moves the preview right (positive) or left (negative), in GUI pixels. -500 to 500.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.yOffset: Moves the preview down (positive) or up (negative), in GUI pixels. -500 to 500.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.subcategory.ca: What the item card shows. Also used for cards you share with Ctrl+C, in either display mode.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.cardMax: How many identifications (with their roll %) the card lists. Extra ones are summed up as "+N more". Cards with very many rows may still be trimmed to fit small screens.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.cardSho: Show powder sockets and the reroll count at the bottom of the card.
Show a shiny item's tracked stat at the bottom of the card.
Show the item's main Nori and Wynnpool scale ratings at the bottom of the card.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.cardFra: Perfect (100%) items get a rainbow frame; defective (0%) ones a flickering grey one. Needs the Wynncraft resource pack.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.subcategory.fl: Used in Floating Item mode, and for items that have no card (such as Corkian Amplifiers).
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.showIte: Show the item's name, roll and badges with the floating item.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.itemNam: Put the name above the floating item instead of below it.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.appearD: How long to hover an item before the preview appears, so it doesn't flash while you move the mouse across the inventory.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.infoDel: Extra time before the item's text appears, on the card and with the floating item.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.textCas: Text slides in line by line (about a quarter second) instead of just appearing.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.idleAni: Gentle motion on the item while you keep hovering it.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.cardIdl: Also play the idle animation on the item inside the card. Off: the card holds it still.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.filters.descri: §7Which items get the big preview. Ctrl+C sharing works on any item with a card, whatever is picked here.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.enableW: Spears, bows, daggers, wands and reliks.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.enableU: Unidentified gear boxes. Their card shows each identification's possible range.
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.no_cloth.messa: Install Cloth Config to change settings in game. Until then, every setting is in the config file below: edit it, save it, then press Reload (or type /wwb reload).
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.no_cloth.reloa: §cCouldn't read the file, so the settings were reset (the old file was kept as .broken)
